accessions: GSE235781 (SubSeries of SuperSeries GSE236600; OH baseline samples deposited in sister SubSeries GSE130977)
assay: bulk RNA-seq of pooled single fibers (MHC I = SLOW, MHC IIa = FAST), vastus lateralis, NextSeq 500

time: POST (4 h after 3x10 knee extensions at 70% 1-RM)

repeated_measure_unit: subject (pre and post biopsies, both fiber types, from the same man)
primary_estimand: Acute resistance-exercise response (4 h POST vs PRE, within subject) of the transcriptome in fast and in slow fibers, separately for each cohort (LLE, YE, OH); fiber and cohort differences in that response are compared descriptively
planned_contrasts: FAST fibers POST vs PRE in LLE (abstract: exercise response, mainly metabolic)
FAST fibers POST vs PRE in YE (abstract: growth + metabolic signature)
FAST fibers POST vs PRE in OH (abstract: stress-related response)
SLOW fibers POST vs PRE in LLE (abstract: only LLE responded; ketone/lipid metabolism)
SLOW fibers POST vs PRE in YE (abstract: no biological response)
SLOW fibers POST vs PRE in OH (abstract: no biological response)
sample_inclusion: 25 men, 100 fiber-pool samples per GEO overall design; GSE235781 holds 81 (OH PRE samples are in GSE130977; YE subject 5 SLOW PRE absent)

paper_threshold.source_locator: abstract reports only 'P < 0.05' for biological responses, not a DEG rule

paper_results: No DEG counts or gene names in the abstract; fast fibers more responsive than slow in all cohorts; slow-fiber response only in LLE
